jobs.description:
Job Posting: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2 (m/f/d)
Transform the everyday.
This role is responsible for leading the global strategy, governance, and execution of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components across the entire supply chain. The individual ensures suppliers, manufacturing processes, quality standards, and material strategies are optimized for cost, quality, productivity, resilience, and sustainability while driving cross-functional collaboration between Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Quality teams worldwide.
In short, this is a senior global leadership position focused on improving supplier performance, product quality, operational efficiency, and supply chain effectiveness throughout the lifecycle of mechanical and mechatronic materials and components.

What we offer you

- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests
- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions
- Diverse health and wellness offerings
- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of Siemens

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.

The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

How you will make an Impact with us

- You will be responsible for the global strategic direction of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components, including drawing-controlled parts, assemblies, manufacturing scopes, and supply chain investments.
- You will lead a team  (either directly or through collaboration models) and provide functional governance for local Material Lifecycle Management teams focused on mechatronics. You will ensure clear roles, standards, decision-making processes, and effective cross-site collaboration.
- You will develop and implement a global strategy for mechatronic parts, processes, and suppliers, focusing on standardization, technical feasibility, quality capability, supply chain resilience, sustainability, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and productivity.
- You will define supplier quality-related processes, methods, and standards for mechanical components and drive their global deployment, application, and continuous optimization across an international network.
- You will oversee preventive quality planning and industrialization readiness, particularly risk assessments, Process FMEA, Control Plans, Production Control Plans, First Article Inspection/PPAP, process audits, and release procedures for drawing-controlled purchased parts.
- You will establish a robust supplier problem management system with clear 8D governance, root cause analysis, effectiveness verification, lessons learned, claims management, and escalation procedures to sustainably reduce quality costs and recurring defects.
- You will further develop global and regional suppliers in collaboration with Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Logistics, and other partners, focusing on process capability, performance, technological expertise, capacity, risk mitigation, and ESG requirements.
- You will drive transparency, digitalization, and data-based management through supplier quality KPIs, audit and action management, quality cost tracking, risk dashboards, and standardized management reporting.
- You will identify productivity opportunities throughout the material lifecycle, including standardization, product variant reduction, make-or-buy optimization, value stream and supply chain analysis, cost and process improvements, and robust relocation and localization strategies.
- You will represent Mechatronics Material Lifecycle Management in global decision-making committees and ensure strategic contributions are integrated early into development, sourcing, investment, and production decisions.

What you bring

Leadership & Governance

- You bring extensive long-term leadership experience in global, multicultural organizations, including both direct people leadership and cross-functional management across sites, functions, and hierarchical levels. You are capable of developing teams, clarifying responsibilities, setting priorities, and driving organizational change effectively.

Mechanical & Mechatronic Components

- You possess a strong understanding of mechanical and mechatronic materials, especially drawing-controlled parts, manufacturing processes, tolerances, inspection concepts, process capability, industrialization, engineering changes, capital investments, and global supply chain risks.

Strategy, Digitalization & Productivity

- You have experience in strategy development, process standardization, digital reporting, data-driven decision-making, productivity programs, and leading complex transformation or optimization initiatives within international manufacturing and supplier networks.

Methodological Expertise

- Knowledge of quality and continuous improvement tools is advantageous, including:
- Process FMEA
- PPAP (Production Part Approval Process)
- 8D Problem Solving
- Ishikawa (Fishbone) Analysis
- 5 Why Analysis
- Pareto Analysis
- Process Audits
- Corrective Action Management
- Lessons Learned Processes
- Control Plans
- KPI and Performance Reviews
- Structured Escalation Processes

Communication & Collaboration

- You are recognized for clear communication, diplomacy, negotiation skills, and the ability to align Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and Suppliers toward common goals. Fluency in both German and English, along with willingness to travel globally to company sites and suppliers, completes your profile.

Languages: Fluent in English, additional languages are a plus

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in CAR-T Cell Therapy (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
The **Children’s Hospital Augsburg (Swabian Children’s Cancer Center) **and the University of Augsburg are looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in CAR-T Cell Therapy and Therapeutic Target Discovery in Pediatric and Rare Tumors to join our interdisciplinary research program at the interface of pediatric oncology, tumor biology, cellular therapy, therapeutic target discovery, and computational cancer biology. The position is a full-time position which is limited to two years.

The Children’s Hospital Augsburg (Swabian Children’s Cancer Center) is part of University Hospital Augsburg (UKA), a rapidly growing academic medical center with 1,699 patient beds across 22 clinics and approximately 2,800 employees. Scientifically, the hospital is a member of the NCT-WERA cooperation and thus one location of the National Center for Tumor Diseases (NCT).

**Research Environment **

- Single-cell, spatial, and multi-omic technologies are providing unprecedented opportunities to characterize tumor composition, heterogeneity, and evolution. Our research program combines these approaches with experimental tumor modeling to identify clinically actionable vulnerabilities in rare and high-risk tumors
- Our group has established a strong track record in the molecular characterization of pediatric and rare tumors, including rhabdoid tumors and other embryonal malignancies. Recent integrative studies have provided new insights into the biology and evolution of these tumors and opened avenues for therapeutic translation (Johann et al., Cancer Cell, 2016; Erkek, Johann et al., Cancer Cell, 2019; Fincke et al., Clinical Cancer Research, 2023; Mucha et al., Communications Medicine, 2025; Fincke et al., Nature Communications, 2026, accepted)
- A central goal of this position is the identification, prioritization, and experimental validation of therapeutic targets in rare entities for which effective treatment options remain limited. Relevant tumor types include DICER1-associated neoplasms, rhabdoid tumors, pediatric and rare melanomas, and other high-risk pediatric malignancies
- The successful candidate will combine molecular and computational analyses with state-of-the-art experimental approaches. CAR-T-cell therapy will represent a major experimental platform for evaluating candidate cell-surface targets and developing targeted cellular therapies
- Together with our partner institutions, we are establishing a growing biobank of patient-derived tumor organoids and other advanced tumor models, enabling systematic investigation of target expression, therapeutic efficacy, and mechanisms of resistance, including in vivo

**Your Responsibilities **

- Identify and prioritize novel therapeutic targets using integrated molecular, single-cell, spatial, and multi-omic data
- Experimentally validate candidate targets using patient-derived models, organoids, and cell lines
- Generate, engineer, and functionally characterize CAR-T cells
- Develop and optimize CAR constructs and cellular therapy strategies
- Evaluate CAR-T-cell efficacy and mechanisms of resistance in vitro and, ideally, in vivo
- Integrate experimental results with bioinformatic and computational analyses
- Develop independent research projects and contribute to grants and collaborative projects
- Publish and present research findings
- Mentor students and junior researchers where appropriate

Requirements

Mandatory

- PhD or equivalent degree in biology, molecular medicine, cancer biology, immunology, biotechnology, or a related field
- Hands-on experience in CAR-T-cell generation, engineering, and functional characterization
- Strong background in experimental cancer or cellular biology
- Experience in independent experimental research and data analysis
- Strong interest in therapeutic target discovery and translational cancer research
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills
- Excellent written and spoken English

Highly desirable

- Experience with therapeutic in vivo testing of CAR-T cells and/or xenograft models
- Experience with tumor organoids or patient-derived models
- Expertise in CAR design, viral transduction, T-cell expansion, flow cytometry, or functional immune-cell assays
- Experience in therapeutic target discovery and validation
- Familiarity with single-cell, spatial, or multi-omic approaches
- Programming skills in R or Python

What we offer

- Remuneration up to pay grade EG 13 TV-L, depending on qualifications and professional experience, including the standard social benefits provided in the public sector (occupational pension scheme and annual special payment)
- The position is initially limited to two years; an extension is intended, subject to funding and successful performance
- An interdisciplinary research environment combining experimental oncology, CAR-T-cell engineering, therapeutic target discovery, and computational cancer biology
- Integration into the research program of the University of Augsburg, with close collaboration with the University Hospital Augsburg and computational research groups
- The opportunity to work on rare and clinically challenging tumor entities, including DICER1-associated neoplasms, rhabdoid tumors, melanomas, and other high-risk pediatric malignancies
- Access to advanced patient-derived tumor models, including a growing collection of tumor organoids
- Opportunities to develop an independent academic profile, publish, present at international conferences, and contribute to grant applications
- International collaborations and opportunities for research visits with academic partner institutions

Contact

For further questions please refer to Prof. Dr. Pascal Johann (Pascal.Johann@uk-augsburg.de)

Role overview

Altera is seeking an experienced Field Sales Engineer to drive growth across an assigned territory in the Central EMEA region. Depending on the candidate’s background and the business need, the role may focus primarily on either:

- Growing territory coverage, distribution customers, and channel-partner design wins; or
- Developing a defined set of strategic customers through focused demand creation and account initiatives.

The successful candidate will combine technical credibility, commercial drive, and strong relationship-building skills to turn customer and market opportunities into sustainable revenue growth.

Job responsibilities

- Develop and execute sales plans to achieve or exceed assigned revenue and design win targets.
- Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities, including early-stage demand creation and design-win activity.
- Manage and grow customer accounts and, where applicable, distribution partners through strong multi-level relationships.
- Own the broader commercial relationship with strategic customers and channel partners, including pricing, contractual terms, volume commitments, supply expectations, and issue escalation.
- Understand customer needs and position Altera’s products and solutions effectively.
- Prepare and deliver sales presentations, product demonstrations, technical proposals, and business cases.
- Drive opportunities through the sales cycle, from prospecting and technical engagement through design win, negotiation, and closure.
- Build joint business plans with channel partners or account plans with strategic customers, depending on the assigned focus.
- Collaborate closely with field application engineering, applications engineering, marketing, product management, and product development.
- Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline data, opportunity plans, and customer information in the CRM system.
- Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and market conditions to identify opportunities and risks.
- Represent Altera at customer meetings, industry events, trade shows, and partner activities.
- Travel regularly within the assigned territory in Central EMEA.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
- At least five years of successful experience in technical sales, field applications, account management, or a comparable customer-facing role, preferably in semiconductors or embedded systems.
- Demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding sales targets.
- Strong understanding of FPGAs, SoCs, and related hardware and software design flows is highly preferred.
- Experience with distribution partners, channel ecosystems, strategic accounts, or technology-driven customer programs.
- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
- Strong customer-development, opportunity-management, forecasting, and CRM skills.
- Self-motivated, proactive, commercially minded, and results-oriented.
- Proficiency with CRM systems such as Salesforce and Microsoft Office or comparable tools.
- Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken, is required.

Willingness to travel frequently within the assigned territory in Central EMEA.

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant / Manager - Risk Management (Liquidity and Market Price Risk) (f|m|x) (Leiter/in - Risikomanagement)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Consultant / Manager (f|m|x), you advise our clients in
the banking sector and financial services industry on complex topics
related to liquidity and market price risk. You analyze their current
situation, identify new requirements early on and, together with your
team, develop tailored solutions – from the initial idea all the way
to implementation. In this role, you effectively drive the continued
development of your clients’ liquidity risk management, enabling
well‑founded decision-making. You assume subject-matter
responsibility, manage collaboration within the project and shape the
content development of our consulting approaches. Your tasks: You
support and lead exciting (sub-)projects at banks and financial
services providers in their liquidity and market price risk
management, taking full responsibility – from gap analyses and the
design of client-specific solutions through to implementation. You
develop integrated management approaches for liquidity and market
price risk, bank-wide liquidity risk stress tests and quantitative
modeling frameworks, for example for risk measurement or interest
rate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you design
methodological frameworks (for example in the ILAAP context) and
develop solutions to implement IRRBB and CSRBB requirements as well as
net interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you also
ensure the effective integration of regulatory requirements, for
instance with respect to ICAAP and ILAAP as well as IRRBB and CSRBB.
You take responsibility for your own deliverables and those of your
team and proactively advance topics. With your strong team orientation
and professionalism, you foster trust-based collaboration – both
within the team and with our clients. You also mentor junior
colleagues, developing both their professional capabilities and
personal strengths, and thus contribute to the team’s growth. You
actively help shape the ongoing enhancement of our consulting
portfolio, identify relevant market potential at an early stage and
derive concrete ideas from it. With your expertise, you support the
development of new offerings and the acquisition of new client
mandates. Your skills: You hold a degree in mathematics, (business)
informatics, physics, statistics or economics, ideally supplemented by
certifications such as FRM or CFA. You have at least three years of
professional experience in consulting or the financial industry.
Proven involvement in leading bank-specific implementation projects in
liquidity and market price risk management is an advantage, and
initial exposure to specialist leadership (for example coordinating
team members) is also part of your profile. You have a solid
understanding of liquidity and market price risk management as well as
the ICAAP and ILAAP frameworks. You confidently apply your analytical
and quantitative skills in modeling and data analysis; programming
skills in Python or R are explicitly welcome. You are familiar with
relevant European and German regulatory requirements, including EBA
Guidelines on IRRBB and CSRBB, SREP requirements, ICAAP and ILAAP.
Initial experience in dealing professionally with external audits is a
plus. You work and think in a structured and solution-oriented manner
and communicate clearly. A client- and team-oriented way of working
comes naturally to you, especially when assuming responsibility within
a team and engaging effectively with different people and situations.
You have excellent command of the German language (at least C1 level,
business-fluent proficiency) and good English language skills (at
least B2 level, fluent), both written and spoken. #LI-LARA #LI-hybrid
Your benefits Insurances & Pension Schemes: Safely on the road with
zeb—in Germany, you are also privately insured via a group accident
insurance policy. For business trips abroad, there is an additional
travel health insurance and you can also take out a company pension
plan with zeb. Mobile Work: Thanks to our technical equipment, remote
work is possible from anywhere – regardless of whether you are on
the train, at home or in the office. zeb.life: Your life is
changing—and we would like to accompany you through the different
phases. zeb.life offers you support for example in childcare, life
situation management and eldercare or in finding concierge services.
Working Time Models: The principle of "trust-based hours” applies
for all our employees, enabling flexible schedules. For permanent
employees, part-time models are also possible: you can develop your
part-time model in consultation with your CDC (Career Development
Counselor) and in consideration of your project and adapt it as
required. Define your working time model according to your personal
needs and adapt your working hours to your current life situation. As
a contract model, Family & More offers a guarantee of travel-free
weekdays that are contractually fixed. Depending on the reduction of
travel activities, your salary will be adjusted for a fixed period of
time.

jobs.occupation: Lead System Engineer (m/f/d) for the NEW ATHENA-WFI satellite project (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics (MPE) in
Garching (near Munich), Germany, is a world-leading institute for
developing and operating state-of-the-art astronomical instruments.
Over the past years, MPE has taken a leading role in the development
of instrumentation for several international space- and ground-based
projects, for example XMM-Newton, Herschel, SRG/eROSITA, EUCLID, the
VLT telescopes (e.g. KMOS, GRAVITY) and Einstein Probe. The MPE
High-Energy group, led by Prof. K. Nandra, carries out major space
hardware programs including the development of X-ray detectors and
X-ray optics in support of its astrophysics research program. Within
the framework of ESA’s future large-class space mission New Athena,
MPE leads the international consortium developing the Wide Field
Imager (WFI), one of the two instruments aboard the X-ray satellite.
Further details about the WFI, which is based on the Max Planck
Society’s unique Silicon DEPFET technology, can be found here:
https://www.mpe.mpg.de/ATHENA-WFI/ The MPE High Energy group is
seeking an experienced Lead System Engineer for the WFI project, who
should in addition have in their earlier career stages been an
accomplished design engineer in any of the primary engineering
disciplines (electronics, optical, mechanical, control and/or software
engineering). As electronics forms the technical core of the
instrument, a design background in electronics engineering is
considered a particular asset. As the Lead System Engineer for the New
Athena WFI, you will be part of the Project Management Team. Working
as a senior member of the WFI team, reporting to the Principal
Investigator and the Project Manager, you will have ample
opportunities to innovate and develop new technical solutions. Lead
System Engineer (m/f/d) for the NEW ATHENA-WFI satellite project Job
Code: 18/2026 Your Tasks: Act as the technical authority for the whole
WFI instrument, establishing, maintaining and controlling the
instrument-level technical baseline throughout the project lifecycle.
Be responsible for the project's technical configuration management.
Work in close and continuous collaboration with the Project Manager,
Project Scientist and the engineering team. Requirements engineering.
Definition and control of technical interfaces (external:
WFI-to-spacecraft; internal: between WFI sub-systems), ensuring
consistency across all responsible sub-system teams. Application of
end-to-end systems analysis and modelling and the subsequent
allocation and management of technical budgets/​tolerances.
Definition of the verification requirements and success criteria that
integration and test plans must satisfy, in coordination with the MAIT
Manager. Support of system integration, verification and testing,
acting as the primary technical interface towards ESA and consortium
partners. Technical Management and Risk Assessment. Prepare technical
documentation for milestones and reviews, assist the Project Manager
with schedule development and resource planning, and monitor
engineering progress against the project schedule, coordinating the
technical actions needed to support timely achievement of engineering
milestones. Your Qualifications: Essential: A completed scientific
university degree (M.Sc. or Dipl.‑Ing.) in engineering or an
equivalent qualification with in‑depth knowledge of scientific
instrumentation development. A physics degree with applicable work
experience in instrumentation development will also be considered.
Desirable: Given that electronics is the technical core of the
instrument, prior design experience in electronics engineering is
regarded as a particular asset, though applicants with a strong
background in the other primary engineering disciplines are equally
encouraged to apply. A higher degree (Ph.D.) in System Engineering
would be an advantage. Knowledge and Experience: Successful candidate
is expected to bring proven systems engineering experience with
designing astronomical or other complex systems. Knowledge of:
Engineering management with a broad knowledge of the technologies
involved in the engineering activities being managed. Principles and
methods of systems engineering and requirements analysis. Technical
risk assessment. Modelling languages, and relevant software tools.
Characterisation methods to evaluate candidate design alternatives.
System integration, tools, test equipment, principles and methods of
validation. Knowledge of ESA design and quality requirements (ECSS
standards) is an advantage. Electronics design principles
(analogue/​digital, front-end and detector electronics) are
considered particularly relevant, given the central role of
electronics in the instrument. Skills: Very good communication skills.
Planning, organising resources, motivating people, measuring
performance and applying corrections where necessary. The ability to
balance technical, schedule, resource and contractual considerations,
and a clear understanding of when a technical decision needs to be
escalated — to the Project Manager or, in more significant cases, to
the Project Office. Fluency in written and spoken English. Fluency in
written and spoken German will be an advantage but is not essential.
We offer: A versatile, challenging and autonomous job in a dynamic and
culturally stimulating international research environment in the
development of satellite instrumentation. Interdisciplinary work in a
team of experienced engineers and physicists. Needs-oriented training
opportunities. Fair payment according to your qualifications and
professional experience in accordance with the collective agreement
for the public service up to pay group 14 (TVöD Bund). Company
pension scheme (VBL). Underground station U6 directly in front of the
institute. Canteen in the immediate vicinity. Reduced rates for
certain insurance policies. Free parking on the institute grounds. The
full-time position is initially time limited until 31st Dec 2027 , but
